description: Lists regions enabled on a specific cloud account. Read-only; sorted deterministically by region id (FR-015).

cloud_account_id.description: Cloud account UUID whose enabled regions should be listed.

regions.description: Regions currently enabled on the cloud account. Stable order: ascending by id.

behavioral_invariants.description: Repeated reads in the same plan/apply MUST return results in identical order.
The Read operation emits exactly one tflog audit record with terraform_op = 'data.nc2_cloud_account_regions.Read'.
